en.heroDesc: Based on long-term value investment and comprehensive brand asset management system, the group develops three core businesses: cultural and creative industry, plateau featured agriculture and artificial intelligence.
en.plat1Desc: Specializes in equity investment, project incubation, post-investment management and cross-border capital allocation, supplying sustainable capital and industrial support for each business entity.

globalItems: China: Covers primary and secondary cities nationwide with mature warehousing, logistics and distribution system

en.visionText: We adhere to stable private holding operation, improving four core capabilities including capital management, brand operation, industrial synergy and global localized management. We export local cultural works, premium plateau agricultural products and self-developed AI technologies via cross-border businesses to build an international industrial cluster with solid risk resistance.
